root_cause.text: The driver incorrectly applied DSC horizontal timing adjustments (compression ratio scaling) in DSI command mode, where it should only be done in video mode, causing the horizontal total (htotal) to become too small and leading to a division-by-zero when computing line_time_us.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `is_vid_mode(intel_dsi) &&` to both `gen11_dsi_set_transcoder_timings()` and `gen11_dsi_get_timings()` conditions, restricting DSC timing adjustments to video mode. The commit message states: "Stop adjusting the horizontal timing values based on the compression ratio in command mode. This should also fix a div-by-zero on some machines because the adjusted htotal ends up being so small that we end up with line_time_us==0".

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix transcoder timings for DSI by applying compression scaling only when in video mode.
intent_record.what: Added `is_vid_mode(intel_dsi)` check to the condition that computes compression-based timing multipliers.
intent_record.how: The scaling factor for compressed vs non-compressed bpp is now only applied when the DSI is in video mode, preventing incorrect timing adjustments in command mode.

intent_record.intent_summary: Guard timing adjustment for DSI compressed bpp to video mode only.
intent_record.what: Added a condition `is_vid_mode(intel_dsi)` to the existing `if (pipe_config->dsc.compressed_bpp_x16)` check.
intent_record.how: The block that computes divider and multiplier for compressed bpp adjustments will now only execute when the DSI is in video mode, preventing incorrect timing calculations in command mode.

grouping_result.intent: Guard timing adjustment for DSI compressed bpp to video mode only.

relevance_review.reason: The group's changes directly guard DSC horizontal timing adjustments to video mode only, preventing the erroneous application in command mode that caused the division-by-zero.
